# Reporter
1.Reporters report directly to the Head of Personnel.
2.Reporters may wear the press armor only if the alert is Blue or above AND they are in immediate danger.
3.While wearing press equipment (holo-pin and vest), reporters may not engage in combat except in self-defense.
4.The HoP may temporarily revoke the reporter's equipment (vest, camera, recorder) or immediately demote them for SOP breaches.
